# 👑 N-Queens Zoo: Educational Simulator & Visualizer CLI

An interactive, educational N-Queens simulator and visualizer CLI designed in Go to teach students the problem through visual attack line heatmaps, narrative backtracking, and ultra-fast heuristics.

## Features

- **🎓 Educational Tutorial Mode**: Step-by-step playback with pedagogical narrative commentary explaining decisions and backtracking steps.
- **🎨 Visual Heatmaps**: Unicode chess boards (`♛`) rendered with colorful ANSI attack heatmaps indicating line of attack and piece influence.
- **⚡ Multiple Solver Strategies (Strategy Pattern)**:
  - **Bitwise Backtracking Solver**: Systematic exhaustive search teaching recursion and pruning.
  - **Min-Conflicts Local Search**: High-performance heuristic capable of finding solutions for $N=1000$ in a few milliseconds.
- **📊 Benchmarking Suite**: Complete with memory allocation and CPU time metrics.
- **🎮 Manual Play Mode**: Practice placing queens on the board with real-time feedback on attacks.

## Getting Started

### Run Educational Tutorial (Default)
```bash
go run cmd/main.go -mode tutorial -n 4
```

### Run Benchmarks (Including High $N$)
```bash
go run cmd/main.go -mode benchmark -n 8
go run cmd/main.go -mode benchmark -n 1000
```

### Manual Play Mode
```bash
go run cmd/main.go -mode play -n 4
```

### Running Tests & Coverage
```bash
go test -v -cover ./...
go test -bench=. ./...
```
